title: Triangulated closure for ell-adic finiteness coefficients
statement: Let X be a scheme with noetherian underlying space and let Λ satisfy IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ell Λ. The bounded complexes of module objects over condensedRingObj Λ X with stratified locally finitely presented homology form a triangulated subcategory of the ambient derived category.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.11(1),(3); Serre heart-closure input for lem-sfb-dc-tensor-preserves, step 10

proof.text: Each constructor of the ell-adic coefficient class supplies Fact ell.Prime and is a constructor of IsFinitenessCoefficient. Apply the proved full finiteness-coefficient triangulatedness instance, explicitly installing its unit-ball constructor in that case. This includes all integral and field presentations without repeating their Serre arguments.
